items.title: Go For Orbit — first revenue Starship mission documentary / recap
items.summary: SpaceX published “Go For Orbit,” covering the first orbital Starship mission to fly advanced Starlink V3 satellites.

items.title: USSF-432 mission
items.summary: SpaceX launched the USSF-432 mission on Falcon 9 from SLC-4E, Vandenberg.

items.title: SpaceX reports third quarter 2026 results
items.summary: Revenue $14.6B (+161% YoY), net income $4.4B, Adjusted EBITDA $8.8B. Connectivity $5.25B with 13.6M Starlink consumer subscribers. SI $7.56B; nameplate compute 1.7 GW. Q1 2027 revenue guided at $33–37B.

items.title: Acquisition of Cursor (Anysphere) — 8-K
items.summary: SpaceX closed the Cursor acquisition and issued unregistered merger shares (later detailed as ~391M shares). Cursor contributed $608M of SI revenue from Aug 14–Sep 30.

items.title: SpaceX reports second quarter 2026 results
items.summary: Revenue $7.8B (+92% YoY). Starlink consumer subscribers 12.0M, ARPU $66. Nameplate compute 1.4 GW. Backlog $47.5B; cash and marketable securities $100B post-IPO.

items.title: SpaceX closes IPO, including full exercise of underwriters’ option
items.summary: 638,888,888 Class A shares issued; gross proceeds approximately $85.7B. Trading began Jun 12 under ticker SPCX on Nasdaq Global Select and Nasdaq Texas.

items.title: SpaceX prices IPO at $135.00 per share
items.summary: 555,555,555 Class A shares priced at $135, plus a 30-day option for 83,333,333 additional shares.

items.title: SpaceX launches initial public offering roadshow
items.summary: Roadshow for 555,555,555 Class A shares; expected price $135; intended ticker SPCX.
